artifacts.summary: Confirms both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect, settles the dispatch's mode-sharing question (the --no-revert untracked-backup enumeration is not shared with default/--branch modes), answers the three ordered questions (scope the enumeration to file_scope with a TASK_DIR-only non-silent fallback; relocate untracked-backup-* to the ephemeral/gitignored class while keeping working-progress-*.patch tracked-eligible; add :(exclude) entries to git-commit-phase.sh's fixed stage_paths seed as belt-and-suspenders, load-bearing for the patch specifically), and flags an out-of-file_scope sibling hazard in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh.

memory_candidates.content: git-snapshot.sh's --no-revert mode's untracked-file backup-to-directory step (UNTRACKED_BACKUP) is NOT shared with default/--branch mode's untracked-file handling: those two modes capture untracked files via `git stash push -u` instead, never writing a directory copy under the task directory. Any future change to the --no-revert untracked enumeration is therefore safely isolated from the other two modes' behavior -- worth checking directly in the script rather than assuming shared code paths in a script with three mode branches.

git-commit-phase.sh and orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh both independently construct an identical fixed stage_paths=("${task_dir}/" ...) directory-pathspec seed for their respective commit surfaces (mid-dispatch phase commit vs. whole-task completion commit). A fix landed in one is not automatically present in the other -- confirmed by direct grep of both files during task 541 research. A future containment-related fix to one of these two seeds should check the other for the same gap before assuming it is isolated.
